# EqManager

EqManager is a robust equipment set management addon for World of Warcraft, designed to handle complex gear swapping needs with ease. It allows users to save, manage, and automatically trigger equipment changes based on a wide variety of in-game events.

EqManager is inspired by the **GearQuipper** addon. While it draws inspiration from GearQuipper's robust equipment management, EqManager is a **complete cleanroom rewrite** designed with a more modular and strictly demarcated architecture. Notably, EqManager **does not include action bar management**, focusing purely on equipment excellence.

## Features

### Set Management
- **Full & Partial Sets**: Save complete equipment sets or subset elements for specific needs.
- **Reconstruction System**: Intelligent tracking of a Base Set and multiple Active Partial Sets, automatically handling un-equips to maintain your desired appearance and stats.
- **Base Set Protection**: Ensures fundamental gear states are maintained by preventing base sets from being unequipped.
- **Base Set Re-equip**: Click the base set label or checkbox to clear all partials and reset to your base gear configuration.
- **Auto-Detect Notifications**: Chat messages alert you when a partial set is detected as equipped or unequipped.
- **Custom Sorting**: Reorder your equipment sets manually using dedicated Up/Down buttons in the main UI.
- **Per-Character Settings**: Each character maintains its own independent configuration, including auto-update preferences and UI options.
- **GearQuipper Import**: Seamlessly migrate all your sets, partial slots, and event bindings from GearQuipper with a single click.

### Equipment Queue & State Machine
- **Safety First**: Queues equipment changes during combat, casting, channeling, or shapeshifting, executing them safely as soon as the lockdown ends.
- **Conflict Resolution**: Handles race conditions by cancelling redundant or conflicting requests in rapid succession.
- **Latency Aware**: Adjustable switch delays to account for home/world latency, preventing server rate-limiting.
- **Delayed Resumption**: Adds a safety buffer after casting or combat ends before resuming swaps, ensuring stability during rapid actions like smelting.
- **Robust Verification**: Automatically verifies equipment states after a swap, with up to 3 automatic retries if items fail to equip/unequip.
- **Resilient Swaps**: Skips missing items with a warning message instead of stopping the swap process, allowing available gear to equip successfully.

### Automated Event Engine
Trigger automatic set swaps based on:
- **Zone Transitions**: Entering or leaving specific zones, Battlegrounds, or Arenas.
- **Player States**: Mounting/Dismounting, entering Stealth, or going AFK.
- **Environment States**: Trigger swaps when Submerging or Emerging from water.
- **Group Dynamics**: Automatically switch gear when joining or leaving a Party or Raid.
- **Class Mechanics**: Druid Forms, Paladin Auras, Death Knight Presences, and Warrior Stances.
- **Action-Level Stance Filters**: Specify fine-grained Druid/Warrior/Priest form filters for individual actions on any Shapeshift or Leave Shapeshift trigger.
- **Form-Specific Exit Triggers**: Bind actions to leaving specific shapeshift forms (e.g., Flight Form) using precise form IDs.
- **Talent Specialization**: Automatic swaps when switching dual-specs with human-readable "Primary" and "Secondary" labels.
- **Expanded Zone Support**: Recursive scanning of multiple continents (Azeroth, Outland, Northrend, etc.) for comprehensive zone-based triggers.
- **PVP Status**: Conditional switches based on PVP combat status.
- **Conditional Filtering**: Specify conditions like PvP status or Location (Outland vs. Azeroth) for each individual event action.

### User Interface & Integration
- **Character Frame Integration**: Seamlessly adds a "SETS" button and labels to the standard PaperDollFrame.
- **Quick Slots**: Alt/Shift-click popups on equipment slots for lightning-fast manual swaps.
- **Visual Feedback**: Highlights missing items (red) and equipped items (green) with clear visual cues.
- **Missing Item Tooltips**: Set names turn red if components are missing; rich tooltips show icons and quality colors for missing pieces, with a Shift-Click option to link them to chat.
- **Bag Dimming**: Customizable dimming modes (Disabled, Non-Set Items, or Set Items) to help organize your inventory and identify clutter. (Supports Baganator and AdiBags).
- **Item Set Tooltips**: Displays set membership information directly on item tooltips with support for partial set indicators and membership status.
- **Event Provenance**: Detailed chat logging that identifies the specific event or manual action that triggered an equipment change.
- **Intelligent Selection**: Clicking a set name automatically selects it for editing and ensures it is equipped so you can immediately configure its slots.
- **Detailed Set Feedback**: Chat messages list exactly which items were updated during a manual save or automatic gear update.
- **Searchable Zone Picker**: A dedicated, searchable, and scrollable picker UI for easily finding zones among hundreds of options.
- **Refined Event Configuration**: Set PvP and Location conditions directly when adding or editing actions for an event.
- **Dynamic Stance Dropdowns**: Configure stance filters directly via a dynamic player-spellbook-aware dropdown when editing event actions, with a manual numeric input fallback.
- **Responsive UI**: Automatically detects and repositions its panes if other UI addons (like Extended Character Stats) are present.

### Compatibility
- Specifically tailored and tested for **Burning Crusade (TBC) Classic**.

### Client API compatibility
Item and bag operations use a shared capability layer (`EqManager.API`), preferring
namespaced APIs and falling back to legacy globals. Item tooltips use
`TooltipDataProcessor` when available and legacy scripts otherwise. Removed helm
and cloak visibility functions are skipped; appearance changes on these clients
must be managed through the game's transmog UI. Saved visibility settings remain intact.
Shapeshift menus normalize old and new return formats. Unsupported events are
skipped, and Retail specialization changes are handled alongside Classic talent groups.
The addon already uses `BackdropTemplate`; its existing dropdowns remain in use.

These changes do not certify every client or guarantee future patch compatibility.
The TOC interface versions must match the client being released for. Combat checks
apply to queued and quickslot swaps; server restrictions still apply.

Before releasing on a new client, enable Lua errors and verify login/reload,
full and partial sets, missing items, quickslots, tooltip membership, bag dimming,
form and specialization events, and a queued swap resumed after combat.
Run `lua tests/compatibility.lua` with Lua 5.1 or newer for mocked API checks.

# EqManager

## [v1.17.7](https://github.com/malkamius/EqManager/tree/v1.17.7) (2026-11-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/EqManager/commits/v1.17.7) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/EqManager/releases)

- chore(release): v1.17.7  
- ci: add GitHub/CurseForge release workflow  
- fix(hooks): support Baganator dimming on Classic Forever  
    Use Baganator.API.Skins.RegisterListener and GetAllFrames to hook individual ItemButton instances since Baganator freezes its item button mixins, and track button instances instead of relying on BGR* global names that are absent in CreateFramePool on Classic Forever and Retail. Also add AGENTS.md rule to auto-deploy changes for testing.  
- fix(ui): resolve nil errors on modern clients  
    Fix client compatibility issues where global item and button APIs  
    were moved or unavailable:  
    - Add EqManager.API.GetItemQualityColor in eqmanager.lua with  
      C\_Item.GetItemQualityColor, ITEM\_QUALITY\_COLORS, and white fallbacks  
    - Update EqManagerUI missing-items tooltip to use API.GetItemQualityColor  
    - Guard quickslot ItemButton creation, ClearAllPoints, and  
      SetItemButtonTexture/Quality calls in EqManagerQuickslot.lua  
    - Add compatibility test assertions for API.GetItemQualityColor  
- chore(deploy): add \_forever\_ client target  
- feat(compat): add multi-client capability layer  
    Implement a unified API capability layer (`EqManager.API`) that  
    dynamically resolves modern (C\_Item, C\_Container, C\_Spell,  
    TooltipDataProcessor) and legacy client globals across Classic Era,  
    TBC Classic, and modern clients.  
    - Resolve bag and item queries through EqManager.API  
    - Handle on-demand Blizzard\_CharacterUI loading and adaptive SETS button  
    - Use TooltipDataProcessor when available with legacy fallback  
    - Support PLAYER\_SPECIALIZATION\_CHANGED alongside Classic talent groups  
    - Improve combat lockdown safeguards in queue and equip functions  
    - Update deploy.ps1 with multi-client path validation and dry-run support  
    - Add compatibility unit tests and update documentation  
- fix(hooks): use corner widget API to hook Baganator buttons  
    Resolve startup crash on "indexed assignment on a frozen table" caused by  
    Baganator freezing its mixin tables. Instead of hooking mixins directly,  
    register a hidden corner widget to hook SetItemDetails on individual  
    button frames as they are initialized. Also add table.isfrozen fallback  
    checks and OptionalDeps metadata to guarantee addon load order.  
- fix(hooks): guard hooksecurefunc calls on mixins  
    Add safety checks to verify that the mixin or prototype method exists  
    before calling hooksecurefunc. This prevents a Lua initialization crash  
    when Baganator (or AdiBags) is loaded but the expected methods (such  
    as SetItemDetails or UpdateAlpha) are missing from the mixin tables.  
- chore: update interface to support both Classic Era and TBC  
    - Update Interface version in TOC to support both Classic Era and TBC  
    - Bump version to 1.17.3  
- chore: update interface version to 11508 for classic era  
    - Update interface version to 11508 in EqManager.toc  
    - Bump version to 1.17.2  
- fix(ui): ignore non-contiguous side-panels  
    Resolve an issue where any descendant frame of the CharacterFrame that  
    was moved far to the right (creating a large gap) would pull our  
    window along with it.  
    Sort all candidate descendant frames by their left coordinate and  
    rebuild the right edge boundary contiguously. Grow the boundary only  
    when the gap between panels is 40 UI units or less. Any larger gap  
    breaks the chain, ignoring detached panels.  
- feat(stance): migrate shapeshift conditions to action level  
    - Move shapeshift/stance conditions from event trigger shell level to individual actions.  
    - Automatically merge duplicate legacy shapeshift event shells and upgrade old configs via database migration #4.  
    - Implement dynamic spellbook stance scanning in eqmanager.lua to list friendly form names.  
    - Update EqManagerEventDialog to support stance filter dropdowns and dynamic form selection.  
    - Update main EqManagerUI with action-level stance configuration, details pane dropdowns, and a Custom ID text input popup.  
    - Fix StaticPopup editBox reference error by using classic \_G fallback for bulletproof editBox retrieval.  
    - Fix stance dropdown list population by correcting scrambled Warrior spell IDs and implementing a highly robust `GetFormIDFromStanceInfo` fallback that resolves stances via spellID, texture paths, or localized names.  
    - Guarantee populated dropdown lists by introducing a static `EqManager.CLASS_STANCES` map that serves standard class-specific stances/forms, combined with dynamically learned stances, ensuring robust options even when stance bars are delayed or unlearned.  
- feat(events): add form-specific exit events and robust mount detection  
    - Implement SHAPESHIFT\_OUT with form ID subtype support.  
    - Add "Leave Shapeshift" to the event configuration UI.  
    - Improve mount/dismount detection during instant shapeshift transitions (e.g., Mount -> Flight Form) by centralizing state checks in CheckMountState.  
    - Track lastFormID to enable filtering on exactly which form was exited.  
- fix(tooltip): hide modifications for unequippable items  
    Prevent EqManager tooltip info from appearing on items that cannot be  
    equipped in character slots 1-19. This includes filtering out non-equippable  
    items (using IsEquippableItem) and explicitly excluding Bags and Quivers.  
- fix(engine): improve swap reliability for channeled actions  
    - Register UNIT\_SPELLCAST\_CHANNEL events to correctly lock swaps during channeling.  
    - Enhance CanSwitch with UnitCastingInfo/UnitChannelInfo fallback checks to prevent race conditions.  
    - Fixes issue where only partial sets were swapped when using the Zapthrottle Mote Extractor while mounted.  
- feat(ui): convert bag dimming to a 3-way dropdown  
    Replace the "Enable Bag Dimming" toggle with a dropdown menu offering  
    "Disabled", "Non-Set Items", and "Set Items" modes. This allows users  
    to choose whether they want to dim items not in any set, or conversely  
    dim items that ARE in sets (to help identify clutter).  
    - Migrate legacy EnableBagDimming setting to BagDimmingMode.  
    - Update hooking logic for Blizzard, AdiBags, and Baganator.  
    - Adjust settings UI layout to accommodate the dropdown.  
- fix(ui): ensure params table is in scope for event dialog handlers  
    Move the `params` table declaration to the top of the `Init` function in  
    EqManagerEventDialog.lua. This fixes a Lua error where clicking the PvP  
    or Location filter buttons would attempt to index a global `params`  
    (which was nil) because the local declaration was originally below  
    the button script definitions.  
- feat(engine): Skip missing items during swap instead of halting  
    Updated VerifySwap to filter out items that are truly missing from bags.  
    Changed the missing item notification from an error to a warning. This  
    allows the swap process to complete for all other present items in the set.  
- feat(engine): Skip missing items during swap instead of halting  
    Updated VerifySwap to filter out items that are truly missing from bags.  
    Changed the missing item notification from an error to a warning. This  
    allows the swap process to complete for all other present items in the set.  
- feat(ui): Enhance missing items tooltip and interactivity  
    Improve the missing items tooltip by adding item icons and quality-colored  
    names. Updated GetMissingItemsForSet to return full item references to  
    facilitate GetItemInfo retrieval. Added Shift-Click interactivity to set
